comments.author: grey-area
comments.story: Wall Street’s Latest Love Affair with Risky Repackaged Debt
comments.why: Explains how CDOs were packaged mortgage debt
comments.text: The 2018 crisis was caused by CDOs - packaged mortgage debt which is going to default, mixed and dressed up as very safe debt, then sold on to some poor sucker (including you in your pension). [VIDEO] The article is saying that people are buying CLOs - packaged corporate debt which is going to default, mixed and dressed up as very safe debt, then sold on to some poor sucker (including you in your pension). TLDR: History repeats itself, first as tragedy, then as farce.
